text:
marina: Quick shoutout — massive thanks to @devin and @samira for jumping into the Acme demo at 3pm and wrestling the auth bug. You both are heroes :tada:

devin: didn't expect that auth token rotation to bite today 😅 glad samira's patch patched it. Also @ryan ran me an HDMI and laptop charger — miracle worker :pray:

ryan: HDMI + charger delivery express service 🚴‍♂️ happy to help. Also brought donuts for the war room :doughnut:

samira: thanks team! Big props to @priya for verifying the replay steps and logging the repro steps — saved us time :sparkles:

priya: no prob! added a tiny test and a one-liner in infra to avoid future surprises. filing a follow-up doc in #eng-runtime later :memo:

marina: noted — sending a tiny thank-you care package to the team. Also, who wants the last blueberry donut? :eyes:

devin: me me me :raised_hands:

lunch-bot: Random Poll — Who wants the blueberry donut? Options: Devin, Ryan, Priya, Samira — Vote now! :ballot_box:

samira: LOL, archive this for posterity. Thanks everyone. Couldn’t have done it without the snack squad :heart:

ryan: high five all around :hand:
